locked_limitation: The direct sequencing attack evidence is limited to tested HG002 nanopore data, selected loci, Dorado configurations, and one F11 clinical worked case.
No patient outcomes were observed and no external clinical validation was performed.
B1/B2/B3 downstream privacy and containment outputs depend on configured synthetic or internal models; only B1 amplification contains an explicit external reference calibration anchor.
GRI is a provenance-aware severity representation for worked cases, not an empirical probability of compromise, clinical harm, or population incidence.
Privacy dimensions D1, D3 and D5 share the B2 lifetime-model family and are not independent replications.
Reported V7 ranges are deterministic sensitivity analyses rather than confidence intervals.
The ten-stage lifecycle is an integration framework; not every adjacent handoff has been observed experimentally end-to-end.
Public repository artifacts for A1 are sanitized; raw crash inputs/reproducers remain private pending responsible disclosure decisions.
